svg.title: Access to jobs, schools and health facilities by public transport, by income decile, in three Brazilian capitals
svg.desc: Three panels, for jobs within 60 minutes and public schools and health facilities within 30 minutes, each with one line per city of the mean share of the city's opportunities reached by public transport, by income decile. Access to jobs rises steeply with income in all three cities; schools, spread across the city, vary much less. Palma ratios for jobs: São Paulo 7.9, Rio de Janeiro 2.3, Belo Horizonte 2.0.
